title: Grateful Dead Live at Des Moines Civic Center on 1980-05-29
lineage: Partial set 1, 2.  Nak 300, FOB right center of stage> Nak 550 > DATs (48) > Sony 60ES > M-Audio Audiophile USB > CDWAV > Golwave minor edits and resampling  > CDWAV tracking > mkwACT SHN; transfer by jbraveman

ai_review.summary: Audience recording with mixed quality but a sizzling Let It Grow and hot Eyes of the World make the show worthwhile for fans.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers are split: two praise the performance, highlighting a scorching "Let It Grow" and an energetic "Eyes of the World," while noting that the tape is a low‑generation audience source that sounds surprisingly clear. One reviewer condemns the sound as poor and points out missing songs, making the overall impression mixed. Overall, the music shines despite the uneven audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Average of the three star ratings (4, 1, 5) yields ~3.3; mixed comments on recording and show quality lead to a moderate confidence level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as low‑generation audience tape that is "mint" by one reviewer, but another calls the sound "shitty" and notes missing songs; overall fidelity is uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers mention a hot, energetic performance with strong peaks on Let It Grow and Eyes of the World; no detailed criticism of set pacing.
